notes: Rank-1 BUB1B biallelic candidate pair on GRCh38. Both calls are PASS heterozygotes (GQ 99; AD 21,25 and 15,13) and affect the same MANE Select transcript NM_001211.6/ENST00000287598.11: c.2210T>G p.(Leu737Ter) plus c.3006T>G p.(Asn1002Lys). The stop allele is an exact 2-star ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic match; the missense allele is an ultra-rare VUS/hypomorphic candidate in the BUBR1 kinase domain. G2P supports definitive biallelic-autosomal BUB1B disease. EPCR 0.50 is an ordinal rank sentinel, not a calibrated probability. Phase is unresolved; parental segregation and functional confirmation are required. Research hypothesis only, not a clinical diagnosis.
